item.title: [AI:cause | EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.2] CVE-2026-109619 - PHP Group PHP
item.description: PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code ex… (CISA KEV added 2026-10-26)

item.title: [AI:cause | EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-109618 - PHP Group PHP
item.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. item.title: [AI:product | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-42010 - Gnu gnutls, Redhat ai inference server
item.description: A flaw was found in gnutls. Servers configured with RSA-PSK (Rivest–Shamir–Adleman – Pre-Shared Key) wrongfully matched usernames containing a NUL character with truncated usernames. A remote attacker could exploit this by sending a specially crafted username, leading to an authentication bypass. This vulnerability allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access by circumventing the authentication process.

item.title: [CRITICAL 10.0] CVE-2026-133993
item.description: A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. This affects the function FUN_0040efb0 of the file gena.cgi of the component GENA Subscription Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument service results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.2] CVE-2026-134352
item.description: Rclone from 1.51.0 before 1.76.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in serve sftp --auth-proxy because the generateCacheKey cache key omits the authentication method. Attackers knowing a victim's base64 public key can submit it as a password from the same client IP to reuse the cached entry and gain read-write VFS access.
